diagrams.title: From sale record to reconciled recovery
diagrams.subtitle: Separate tax-sale and foreclosure procedures
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values indicate sequence, not duration or probability of recovery.
diagrams.caption: A posted surplus is an investigation starting point; verify custody, priority and entitlement before estimating a claimant's proceeds.

stages.label: Identify sale
stages.detail: Record parcel, case number, sale date and whether the sale was tax-related or mortgage foreclosure.

stages.label: Verify funds
stages.detail: Reconcile the sale accounting with the current custodian ledger; exclude paid, transferred or duplicated balances.

stages.label: Resolve priority
stages.detail: Trace title, lien claims and the claimant's identity; refer disputed ranking and entitlement to counsel.

stages.label: Document authority
stages.detail: Check deadlines and permitted compensation; assemble the signed engagement and evidence of representative authority.

stages.label: Submit and reconcile
stages.detail: Use the custodian or court procedure, track objections and reconcile distribution against collected fees.

diagrams.title: Screen for recoverable value, not list size
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 200 sale records
diagrams.assumptions_note: Invented nested cohort counts; no observed conversion rate or collection forecast is implied.
diagrams.caption: Keep a reason code for every rejected record and distinguish an engaged claimant from an actual cash collection.

stages.label: Sale records
stages.detail: Deduplicated case and parcel records from one defined acquisition period.

stages.label: Balance verified
stages.detail: Custodian confirmation supports a still-held balance rather than a stale auction-list amount.

stages.label: Net claim plausible
stages.detail: Preliminary lien and deadline screening leaves a potentially economic claimant share.

stages.label: Claimants engaged
stages.detail: Eligible claimants choose assistance after receiving a clear scope and fee calculation.

stages.label: Fees collected
stages.detail: Resolved cases with cleared business receipts; pending matters remain outside this count.

diagrams.title: Collected fee to case contribution
diagrams.subtitle: Keep the claimant distribution separate
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD; opening and closing bars are totals, intervening bars are signed deductions. Assume a permitted 10% fee on a $50,000 claimant recovery.
diagrams.caption: $5,000 collected less $600 records, $900 professional review and $1,000 acquisition allocation leaves $2,500 before overhead, owner compensation and tax.

stages.label: Collected fee
stages.detail: Opening total; assumes lawful compensation and actual receipt, not an unsigned prospective fee.

stages.label: Evidence costs
stages.detail: Certified deeds, docket copies, identity documents and research labor paid by the business.

stages.label: Professional review
stages.detail: Illustrative business-paid review cost; not a statutory deduction from claimant proceeds.

stages.label: Acquisition allocation
stages.detail: Includes outreach and screening expense for unsuccessful records in the same cohort.

stages.label: Case contribution
stages.detail: Closing total, not another movement; deduct fixed overhead before describing owner profit.

diagrams.title: Test fee sensitivity before choosing a market
diagrams.subtitle: Hypothetical ceilings, not a state-law comparison
diagrams.assumptions_note: Percent of a $50,000 claimant recovery. A-D are fictional jurisdictions; these values assert no actual statutory cap.
diagrams.caption: A percentage ceiling alone does not establish an enforceable agreement; claim type, timing, permitted services and the compensation base also matter.

stages.label: Hypothetical A
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling only; verify the governing sale procedure and any waiting period.

stages.label: Hypothetical B
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling, not a recommendation to charge the maximum.

stages.label: Hypothetical C
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling; reimbursed expenses may count toward allowed compensation.

stages.label: Hypothetical D
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling; legal representation and assignment restrictions remain separate questions.

diagrams.title: Resolve priority before pricing a claim
diagrams.subtitle: A triage tree, not an automatic payout formula
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numbers identify nodes; branch directions are in the details. Applicable law and court orders control entitlement and ranking.
diagrams.caption: Do not subtract every recorded lien mechanically: verify the sale type, lien status, priority, filed claims and the distribution procedure.

stages.label: Funds still held?
stages.detail: Yes: continue to node 2. No: locate the transfer or distribution record before further acquisition spending.

stages.label: Claimant authority proven?
stages.detail: Yes: continue to node 3. No: obtain identity, title or estate authority documents; do not assume a relative can sign.

stages.label: Competing claims resolved?
stages.detail: Yes: continue to node 4. No: send the docket, title chain and lien instruments for professional priority analysis.

stages.label: Economic remainder?
stages.detail: Positive documented remainder: prepare the permitted claim. Zero or uncertain remainder: close or hold with a recorded reason.

diagrams.title: Two full-time operators, two contract specialists
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative base-team allocation
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are role identifiers, not employee counts or pay. The owner and coordinator are full-time; research and counsel are contract roles.
diagrams.caption: The owner manages case economics; the coordinator manages records and communication. Contract specialists retain responsibility for their assigned work.

stages.label: Owner / case lead
stages.detail: Owns market selection, budgets, engagements and cash reconciliation; supervises coordinator and research deliverables.

stages.label: Records / client coordinator
stages.detail: Reports to owner; maintains custodian confirmations, deadline calendars and claimant document requests.

stages.label: Title / records researcher
stages.detail: Delivers sourced title and docket packets to the case lead; flags contradictions without deciding disputed entitlement.

stages.label: Independent counsel
stages.detail: Provides separately scoped professional review or representation; sales targets do not determine legal conclusions.

diagrams.title: Fund the work before the first distribution
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative $10,000 business cash stack
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD; four additive components total $10,000 for one pilot scenario. Owner living expenses, income tax and ongoing salaries are excluded; obtain local quotes.
diagrams.caption: The cash reserve is unspent liquidity, not a fee expense. A startup allowance does not fund a two-person payroll indefinitely.

stages.label: Setup and review
stages.detail: Formation, initial engagement review and insurance allowance; actual costs depend on services and jurisdiction.

stages.label: Tools and records
stages.detail: Initial secure case system, records access and communication tools for a bounded pilot.

stages.label: Pilot case work
stages.detail: Certified documents, postage and contract research across successful and rejected cases.

stages.label: Uncommitted reserve
stages.detail: Liquidity for delays and rework; keep separate from projected receivables and claimant funds.

diagrams.title: Thirty days to a reviewable recovery operation
diagrams.subtitle: Readiness milestones, not a payout schedule
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are milestone end-days. Ranges are operating targets, not statutory filing periods or expected collection dates.
diagrams.caption: The month should end with documented cases, actual spending and a decision on the next cohort; a pending distribution is not collected revenue.

stages.label: Select one lane
stages.detail: Choose one county and sale type; identify the custodian, claim procedure, compensation rules and deadlines.

stages.label: Build the case desk
stages.detail: Configure record provenance, duplicate checks, engagement documents, case budgets and a deadline calendar.

stages.label: Screen a pilot cohort
stages.detail: Verify balances, trace ownership and record rejection reasons before committing to expensive evidence work.

stages.label: Review and iterate
stages.detail: Review evidence completeness, professional-review needs and cash runway; resize the next cohort using measured costs.
